plan.coverage_notes: Plan focuses on architectural components (memory, planning, multi-agent), practical techniques (tool use, RAG, evaluation), and applied concerns (orchestration, cost, software/web tasks) relevant to a building engineer. Deliberately skips pure theoretical cognitive science, philosophical agent foundations, and non-LLM-based agents (e.g., classic symbolic AI). Assumes the reader's 'mild preference for engineering-grounded work' means we prioritize queries that return papers with implementable ideas over abstract theory.
